player_prompt.intro:
Ko koe te Kaitakaro {player_id} i Connect Four.
Te tohu whakapapa mou: {symbol}.
Ko te papa whakapapa kei {num_rows} rārangi me {num_cols} kohatu.
Ko ngā kaitakaro e tū mai ana, e whakataka ana i tō rātou whakapapa ki tetahi o ngā kohatu (0 ki {end_col}).
Ko te kaitakaro tuatahi e hono (ōna ake) whakapapa whā, whakapapa whānui, whakapapa ki raro ranei e wini.
I tō wā, whakauru te numera kohatu i roto i ngā kōwhiri ki te mahi.
Hei tauira: '[col 4]' rānei '[col 1]'.

board.board_notvisible_state: Kaore e kitea te papa takaro ki nga kaitakaro.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Kaitakaro {player_id}, Tukanga mahi hē. I tūmanako ai ki te tukanga: '[col x]'.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Kaitakaro {player_id}, Mahi hē. Ko te kohatu {col} kei waho o ngā rohe.
invalid_move.already_full: Kaitakaro {player_id}, Mahi hē. Ko te kohatu {col} kua ki.

action.dropped_disk: Kaitakaro {player_id} i whakataka i tōna whakapapa ({player_symbol}) ki roto i te kohatu {col}.

outcome.win: Ka wikitoria te kaitākaro {player_id} mā te hono i ngā whā!
outcome.draw: I mutu te kēmu i runga anō.
